Application Areas

Healthcare, wearables & wellbeing

We study activity and stress recognition, fall detection, and privacy-aware medical AI. Our work examines the reliability of wearable and multimodal data, the security of learning pipelines, and resource-efficient assistance in health-related settings.

Consumer AI, digital media & online privacy

We investigate privacy and trust in everyday writing, audio, image-editing and digital communication tools. Topics include sensitive-attribute inference, AI-generated content, image-edit provenance, and forensic traces left by AI applications.

Transportation & mobility

We study driving-scene understanding, driver-awareness monitoring and connected autonomous systems. Our research also addresses location-based services and mobility privacy, with attention to adversarial robustness and resource-constrained sensing.

Workplace & public safety

We explore construction-hazard recognition, worker-health assessment, fall detection and safety communication. Related research examines wearable-camera and robotic sensing for situational awareness, while evaluating reliability, privacy risks and the need for human oversight.

Smart environments & connected infrastructure

We investigate privacy and security in connected devices, mobile sensing and edge-based intelligence. Application settings include smart homes, distributed IoT networks and connected infrastructure, where trustworthy data sharing and efficient computation are central concerns.
